domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用基本激励响应表示系统动力作用的函数。
usage_overview: 在板式轨道—路基动力分析中，以单位脉冲荷载引起的响应表征子系统的动力作用，用于计算荷载作用下该子系统的运动。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: A Green’s function-based hybrid dynamic model with high efficiency is established to achieve the long-distance analysis of the vehicle-track-subgrade interaction system with a wide range of subgrade settlement.
To achieve the high-efficient analysis of the VTS interaction with large DOFs, a Green’s function-based hybrid model is established.
